purpose: Teach: 手のひら/アクセント/モーニング/出来上がり/隣人/いわく/たかが/まかせ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の手のひら、サインしてやるぜ
lines.style: Light, teasing energy with a playful smile in the voice. Quick tempo. Leans into the challenge—she's offering something he didn't ask for and daring him to accept it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語のアクセントいいな、桜
lines.en: You've got a good English accent, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft admission wrapped in a compliment. Slight surprise underneath—she caught him off-guard. Genuine but careful, like he's testing whether she'll accept the observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、モーニングサービスのカフェ知ってる?
lines.en: Riku, do you know that café with the morning service?
lines.style: Casual shift in topic, but intentional. Lighter tone—genuine curiosity. Not performing, just asking. Eyes probably on him to gauge his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の手作り、出来上がり完璧だな、桜
lines.en: Your handmade thing turned out perfect, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter compliment, almost conversational. Not overdone. A small, steady observation that carries weight because he doesn't throw praise around easily.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、隣人さん、お前に挨拶してくれたって?
lines.en: Riku, the neighbor said hello to you?
lines.style: Slight rise at the end—genuine interest, not skepticism. Testing his answer. Warm underneath the teasing exterior. Leaning in a little.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さんいわく、勉強より体力が大事って、桜
lines.en: Your dad says fitness matters more than studying, apparently.
lines.style: Reflective, almost thoughtful. Not lecturing. Quoting him like she's turning it over in her head. Slow, measured delivery—she's offering him something to think about.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、たかがテストで落ち込むなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't let a test get you down over this.
lines.style: Firmer now. Steady reassurance without pity. Direct gaze. Not coddling—respecting his ability to bounce back. Tone says she's seen him fall before and knows he gets back up.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ぼくにグループワークまかせるなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't put me in charge of the group work, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware humor masking real worry. Slight laugh at the end—he's joking but he means it. Underneath is the anxiety that he'll let her down. Quick, deflecting pace.
